verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms RustDesk serves an llms.txt at rustdesk.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and that file gives an agent a substantive product summary covering the OSS and Pro servers, features, plans and Wayland support. Pointing an agent at it is therefore a first-party, documented path. The supporting agent-oriented docs are thin: the markdown docs variant returns 404. Missing for 10: markdown/agent-readable versions of the full docs (docs .md returned 404), evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or deeper linked doc coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://rustdesk.com/llms.txt # RustDesk
Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
Server OSS: a free, open-source ID/rendezvous server (hbbs) and relay server (hbbr) that you can deploy on your own infrastructure.
